name: OneGate Vault
description: A free local lucky-draw game with three tiers, animated prize reveals, and a local leaderboard. No wallet, GAS, contract call, or oracle is used while the RangeGasPool deployment and GameFi settlement path remain under validation.
description_zh: 免费的本地幸运抽奖游戏，包含三个档位、动画揭奖和本地排行榜。RangeGasPool 部署与 GameFi 结算路径完成验证前，不使用钱包、GAS、合约调用或预言机。
description_ja: 3つの段、アニメーション付きの景品公開、ローカルランキングを備えた無料の抽選ゲームです。RangeGasPoolのデプロイとGameFi決済経路の検証が完了するまで、ウォレット、GAS、コントラクト、オラクルは使用しません。

operation_panel.title: OneGate Vault
operation_panel.subtitle: Play the local lucky draw directly. Verified GAS operations are hidden until the GameFi settlement path passes testnet validation.

aa.description: Local guest play does not connect a wallet or request account-abstraction execution.

tee.description: Local guest play does not make TEE requests.

vrf.description: The current RangeGasPool implementation uses Neo Runtime.GetRandom rather than a verified VRF callback, and the published hashes do not expose the RangeGasPool ABI. GameFi remains disabled until both are resolved and tested.

neodid.description: Local guest play does not use identity gating.
